import { computed, defineComponent, type PropType, ref } from 'vue'
import { DatePicker, Popup } from 'vant'
import { DateTime } from '@/shared/dateTime.ts'
import { genDateArrayOfToday } from '@/const/genDateArrayOfToday.ts'

export const DatePickerPopup = defineComponent({
  name: 'DatePickerPopup',
  props: {
    popupVisible: { type: Boolean as PropType<boolean>, default: false, },
    dateStrArray: { type: Array as PropType<string[]>, default: () => genDateArrayOfToday(), }
  },
  emits: ['update:popupVisible', 'update:dateStrArray'],
  setup( _props, _ctx ) {
    const lastDateRef = ref<string[]>(_props.dateStrArray ?? genDateArrayOfToday())
    const [minDate, maxDate,] = [
      new DateTime(new Date()).add(-1, 'year').getRawDate(),
      new DateTime(new Date()).add(1, 'year').getRawDate(),
    ]
    const getPopupVisible = computed({
      get: () => _props.popupVisible,
      set: (value) => _ctx.emit('update:popupVisible', value),
    })
    const getDateStrArray = computed({
      get: () => _props.dateStrArray,
      set: (value) => _ctx.emit('update:dateStrArray', value),
    })
    const confirmDate = ({ selectedValues }: { selectedValues: string[] }) => {
      lastDateRef.value = selectedValues
      getDateStrArray.value = selectedValues
      getPopupVisible.value = false
    }
    const cancelDate = () => {
      getDateStrArray.value = lastDateRef.value
      getPopupVisible.value = false
    }
    return () => (
      <Popup
        position="bottom"
        v-model:show={getPopupVisible.value}
        onClose={cancelDate}>
        <DatePicker
          title="选择年月日"
          v-model={getDateStrArray.value}
          minDate={minDate}
          maxDate={maxDate}
          onConfirm={confirmDate}
          onCancel={cancelDate}/>
      </Popup>
    )
  },
})

import { computed, defineComponent, type PropType, ref } from 'vue'
import { DatePicker, Popup } from 'vant'
import { DateTime } from '@/shared/dateTime.ts'
import { genDateStr } from '@/const/genDateStr.ts'

export const DatePickerPopup = defineComponent({
  name: 'DatePickerPopup',
  props: {
    popupVisible: { type: Boolean as PropType<boolean>, default: false, },
    dateStr: { type: String as PropType<string>, default: () => genDateStr(), }
  },
  emits: ['update:popupVisible', 'update:dateStr',],
  setup( _props, _ctx ) {
    const lastDateStrRef = ref<string>(_props.dateStr ?? genDateStr())
    const [minDate, maxDate,] = [
      new DateTime(new Date()).add(-1, 'year').getRawDate(),
      new DateTime(new Date()).add(1, 'year').getRawDate(),
    ]
    const getPopupVisible = computed({
      get: () => _props.popupVisible,
      set: (value) => _ctx.emit('update:popupVisible', value),
    })
    const getDateStrArrayTransfer = computed({
      // '2026-10-22' -> [2026, 10, 22]
      get: () => _props.dateStr.split('-'),
      // [2026, 10, 22] -> '2026-10-22'
      set: (value: string[]) => _ctx.emit('update:dateStr', value.join('-')),
    })
    const confirmDate = ({ selectedValues }: { selectedValues: string[] }) => {
      lastDateStrRef.value = selectedValues.join('-') // '2026-10-22'
      getDateStrArrayTransfer.value = selectedValues // [2026, 10, 22]
      getPopupVisible.value = false
    }
    const cancelDate = () => {
      getDateStrArrayTransfer.value = lastDateStrRef.value.split('-') // [2026, 10, 22]
      getPopupVisible.value = false
    }
    return () => (
      <Popup
        position="bottom"
        v-model:show={getPopupVisible.value}
        onClose={cancelDate}>
        <DatePicker
          title="选择年月日"
          v-model={getDateStrArrayTransfer.value}
          minDate={minDate}
          maxDate={maxDate}
          onConfirm={confirmDate}
          onCancel={cancelDate}/>
      </Popup>
    )
  },
})
  • 外部传参改为 dateStr
  • 发布事件名称改为 'update:dateStr'
  • 引用该组件的双向绑定需要改为 v-model:dateStr={}
  • 可写的计算属性 getDateStrArrayTransfer 需要在 '2026-10-22' <-> [2026, 10, 22] 格式之间转换
    • 返回值使用 dateStr.split('-') 转换 '2026-10-22' -> [2026, 10, 22]
    • 设置值使用 value.join('-') 转换 [2026, 10, 22] -> '2026-10-22'
  • 其他相关数据涉及同样修改
    • lastDateStrRef
    • confirmDate
    • cancelDate

import { computed, defineComponent, type PropType, ref, type UnwrapRef, useId } from 'vue'
import { EmojiSelector } from '@/modules/tags/EmojiSelector.tsx'
import { cn } from 'cn'
import type { FormDataType } from '@/shared/validator/formValidate.ts'
import { BarButton } from '@/components/BarButton.tsx'
import { LabelOrDivWrapper } from '@/components/form/LabelOrDivWrapper.tsx'
import { DatePickerPopup } from '@/components/form/DatePickerPopup.tsx'

export type FormItemType = 'text' | 'emojiSelector' | 'date' | 'submit-button'

interface FormItemProps {
  modelValue?: UnwrapRef<FormDataType[string]>
  type?: FormItemType
  error?: string
  hasErrorPlaceholder?: boolean
  label?: string
  hasLabelColon?: boolean
}

export const FormItem = defineComponent<FormItemProps>({
  name: 'FormItem',
  props: {
    label: { type: String as PropType<string>, default: '', },
    hasLabelColon: { type: Boolean as PropType<boolean>, default: true, },
    type: { type: String as PropType<FormItemType>, },
    modelValue: {
      type: [String, Number, null, undefined,] as PropType<UnwrapRef<FormDataType[string]>>,
      default: '',
    },
    error: { type: String as PropType<string>, },
    hasErrorPlaceholder: { type: Boolean as PropType<boolean>, default: false, },
  },
  emit: ['update:modelValue',],
  setup( _props, _ctx ) {
    const extraHint = ref('')
    const getModelValue = computed({
      get() {return _props.modelValue?.toString()},
      set(value) {_ctx.emit('update:modelValue', value)}
    })
    const getIfNeedLabelFor = computed(() =>
      ['text', 'submit-button'].includes(_props?.type ?? ''))
    const getLabelFor = computed(() => getIfNeedLabelFor.value
        ? `form-item-${_props.type}-${useId()}`
        : '')

    const dateVisibleRef = ref(false)
    const itemContent = computed(() => {
      switch (_props.type) {
        case 'text':
          return (
            <input
              id={getLabelFor.value}
              type="date"
              v-model={getModelValue.value}
              class={
                cn(
                  'p-x-1em text-18px',
                  'b-1 rounded-[var(--input-radius)] shadow-[inset_0_0_3px_var(--input-shadow)]',
                  _props.error ? 'b-[var(--error-color)]' : 'b-[var(--input-border-color)]',
                )
              }/>
          )
        case 'emojiSelector':
          return (
            <EmojiSelector
              v-model={getModelValue.value}
              hasError={!!_props.error}
              v-model:extraHint={extraHint.value} />
          )
        case 'submit-button':
          return <BarButton id={getLabelFor.value} type="submit">确定</BarButton>
        case 'date':
          return (
            <>
              <input
                id={getLabelFor.value}
                readonly={true}
                value={getModelValue.value}
                onClick={() => {dateVisibleRef.value = true}}
                class={
                  cn(
                    'p-x-1em text-18px',
                    'b-1 rounded-[var(--input-radius)] shadow-[inset_0_0_3px_var(--input-shadow)]',
                    _props.error ? 'b-[var(--error-color)]' : 'b-[var(--input-border-color)]',
                  )
                }/>
              <DatePickerPopup
                v-model:popupVisible={dateVisibleRef.value}
                v-model:dateStr={getModelValue.value} />
            </>
          )
        case undefined:
          return _ctx.slots.default?.()
      }
    })
    return () => (
      <div class="mt-.5em">
        <LabelOrDivWrapper
          ifUseLabelTag={getIfNeedLabelFor.value}
          labelFor={getLabelFor.value}>
          {/* 标题 */}
          {_props.label &&
            <span class="label_name">
              {_props.label}{_props.hasLabelColon ? '：' : ''}{extraHint.value}
            </span>
          }
          {/* 内容 */}
          <div class={cn('content-value flex mt-0.25em grow-1 children:grow-1 min-h-[var(--input-min-height)] max-w-100%')}>
            {itemContent.value}
          </div>
          {/* 错误 */}
          {
            (_props.error || _props.hasErrorPlaceholder)  &&
            <div class={cn('error-hint min-h-18px m-t-.25em text-12px color-[var(--error-color)]')}>
              <span>{_props.error}</span>
            </div>
          }
        </LabelOrDivWrapper>
      </div>
    )
  },
})
  • 添加 type 类型的 FormItem
    • 只读属性 readonly={true}
    • 数据为日期字符串 value={getModelValue.value}
    • 点击打开日期选择弹出框 onClick={() => {dateVisibleRef.value = true}}

import { defineComponent, reactive, ref, watchEffect } from 'vue'
import { MainLayout } from '@/components/layout/MainLayout.tsx'
import { SvgIcon } from '@/components/icons/SvgIcon.tsx'
import { SwitchTabs } from '@/components/tab/SwitchTabs.tsx'
import { ItemTab } from '@/components/tab/ItemTab.tsx'
import { ItemSummary } from '@/modules/items/ItemSummary.tsx'
import { DateTime } from '@/shared/dateTime.ts'
import { FloatButton } from '@/components/FloatButton.tsx'
import { Overlay } from 'vant'
import { FormContainer } from '@/components/form/FormContainer.tsx'
import { FormItem } from '@/components/form/FormItem.tsx'

export const ItemList = defineComponent({
  name: 'ItemList',
  setup(/* _props, _ctx */) {
    const selectedDateRef = ref('本月')
    const currentDate = new DateTime()
    const customDate = reactive<{ start: string; end: string }>({
      start: currentDate.getOriginDate()?.format(),
      end: currentDate.getOriginDate()?.format()
    })
    const dateList = [
      {start: currentDate.firstDayOfMonth(), end: currentDate.lastDayOfMonth()},
      {
        start: currentDate.subtract(1, 'month').firstDayOfMonth(),
        end: currentDate.subtract(1, 'month').lastDayOfMonth()
      },
      {start: currentDate.firstDayOfYear(), end: currentDate.lastDayOfYear()},
    ] as const
    const refOverlayVisible = ref(false)
    watchEffect(() => {
      refOverlayVisible.value = selectedDateRef.value === '自定义日期范围'
    })
    // 表单操作
    const onSubmitCustomDateRange = (e: SubmitEvent) => {
      e.preventDefault()
      refOverlayVisible.value = false
    }
    const onCnacelCustomDateRange = () => {
      refOverlayVisible.value = false
    }
    return () => (
      <MainLayout>
        {{
          title: () => '山竹记账',
          icon: () => <SvgIcon name="menu" class="w-2em h-2em" />,
          default: () => (
            <div class="h-full flex flex-col">
              <SwitchTabs
                selected={selectedDateRef.value}
                v-model:selected={selectedDateRef.value}
                class="[&>nav>menu>li]:(text-start grow-0)">
                <ItemTab tabName="本月" tabId="thisMonth">
                  <ItemSummary
                    startDate={dateList[0].start.format()}
                    endDate={dateList[0].end.format()} />
                </ItemTab>
                <ItemTab tabName="上月" tabId="lastMonth">
                  <ItemSummary
                    startDate={dateList[1].start.format()}
                    endDate={dateList[1].end.format()} />
                </ItemTab>
                <ItemTab tabName="今年" tabId="thisYear">
                  <ItemSummary
                    startDate={dateList[2].start.format()}
                    endDate={dateList[2].end.format()} />
                </ItemTab>
                <ItemTab tabName="自定义日期范围" tabId="customDateRange">
                  <ItemSummary
                    startDate={customDate.start}
                    endDate={customDate.end} />
                </ItemTab>
              </SwitchTabs>

              {/* 自定义日期范围弹出层 */}
              <Overlay
                show={refOverlayVisible.value}
                onClick={() => (refOverlayVisible.value = false)}
                class="flex items-center justify-center b-3 b-solid b-red bg-[var(--overlay-mask-bg)]" >
                <div
                  onClick={(e: MouseEvent) => e.stopPropagation()}
                  class="bg-[var(--overlay-bg)] w-80vw">
                  <header class="bg-[var(--main)] text-[var(--dialog-header-text)] py-12px px-1em">
                    请选择时间
                  </header>
                  <main>
                    <FormContainer onSubmit={onSubmitCustomDateRange}>
                      <FormItem type="date" label="开始时间" v-model={customDate.start} />
                      <FormItem type="date" label="结束时间" v-model={customDate.end} />
                      <footer class="flex justify-between mt-1em children:(w-[calc(50%-.25em)])">
                        <FormItem type="button" onClick={onCnacelCustomDateRange} buttonConfig={{level: 'default', text: '取 消' }}/>
                        <FormItem type="submit-button" buttonConfig={{level: 'primary', text: '确 认' }}/>
                      </footer>
                    </FormContainer>
                  </main>
                </div>
              </Overlay>

              <FloatButton class="fixed bottom-1em right-1em" iconName="add" />
            </div>
          ),
        }}
      </MainLayout>
    )
  },
})

import { ItemTab } from '@/components/tab/ItemTab.tsx'
import { cn } from 'cn'

export const SwitchTabs = defineComponent({
name: 'SwitchTabs',
props: {
selected: {
  type: String as PropType<string>,
},
},
setup(_props, _ctx) {
const selectedClass = (tabName: string) =>
  _props.selected === tabName
    ? cn(
        'relative',
        `after:(content-[""] block absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-full h-4px bg-[var(--tabs-indicator-bg)])`,
      )
    : ''

return () => {
  const defaultSlotTabs = _ctx.slots?.default?.() ?? []
  const ifAllItemTab = defaultSlotTabs.every(
    (slot) => slot.type === ItemTab && !!slot.props?.tabName,
  )
  if (!ifAllItemTab) {
    throw new Error(`SwitchTabs: 子组件必须是 ItemTab，且必须有 tabName 属性`)
  }

  return (
    <div class="grow-1 shrink-1 overflow-auto scrollbar-hide relative">
      {/* 切换标签 */}
      <nav class="sticky left-0 top-0 z-1">
        <menu class="flex items-center text-color-[var(--navbar-text-color)]">
          {defaultSlotTabs.map((slot, index) => (
            <li
              key={index + slot?.props?.tabName}
              class={cn(
                'grow-1 shrink-0 text-center',
                'p-y-12px bg-[var(--navbar-bg-end)]',
                selectedClass(slot?.props?.tabName),
              )}
              onClick={() => {
                _ctx.emit('update:selected', slot?.props?.tabName)
              }}>
              {slot?.props?.tabName}
            </li>
          ))}
        </menu>
      </nav>

      {/* 标签内容-插槽-数组 */}
      <section>
        {defaultSlotTabs.find((slot) => slot.props?.tabName === _props.selected)}
      </section>
    </div>
  )
}
},
})

import type { VNode } from 'vue'

export const genDefaultSlotTabs = (slots: Array<VNode>): VNode[] =>
  slots.flatMap((slot) =>
    typeof slot?.type === 'symbol' && Symbol.keyFor(slot?.type as symbol) === 'v-fgt'
      ? genDefaultSlotTabs(slot.children as VNode[])
      : slot,
  )
  • 使用 Symbol.keyFor(slot?.type as symbol) === 'v-fgt' 判断是否为文档片段
  • 递归判断节点是否为文档片段，并返回拍平后的节点数组

import { defineComponent, type PropType } from 'vue'
import { cn } from 'cn'

type ButtonFeatType = 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset'
type ButtonLevelType = 'primary' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger'

interface BarButtonProps {
  onClick?: (e: MouseEvent) => void
  type?: ButtonFeatType
  level?: ButtonLevelType
}

export const BarButton = defineComponent<BarButtonProps>({
  name: 'BarButton',
  props: {
    type: {type: String as PropType<ButtonFeatType>, default: 'button' as const,},
    level: {type: String as PropType<ButtonLevelType>, default: 'primary' as const,},
  },
  setup(_props, ctx) {
    const levelHashClass: Record<ButtonLevelType, string> = {
      primary: cn('bg-[var(--button-bg-primary)] b-[var(--button-bg-primary)]'),
      success: cn('bg-[var(--button-bg-success)] b-[var(--button-bg-success)]'),
      warning: cn('bg-[var(--button-bg-warning)] b-[var(--button-bg-warning)]'),
      danger: cn('bg-[var(--button-bg-danger)] b-[var(--button-bg-danger)]'),
    }

    return () => (
      <button
        type={_props.type}
        class={cn(
          `${levelHashClass[_props.level ?? 'primary']}`,
          'b-1 b-solid rounded-[var(--button-radius)]',
          'text-[var(--button-text-color)] font-size-[var(--button-text-size)]',
          'w-[100%] h-[var(--button-height)] p-x-1em p-y-[0.5em]',
        )}>
        {ctx.slots.default?.()}
      </button>
    )
  },
})

export const SwitchTabs = defineComponent({
  name: 'SwitchTabs',
  props: {
    selected: {
      type: String as PropType<string>,
    },
  },
  setup(_props, _ctx) {
    const selectedClass = (tabName: string) =>
      _props.selected === tabName
        ? cn(/* ... */)
        : ''

    return () => {
      const defaultSlotTabs = genDefaultSlotTabs(_ctx.slots?.default?.() ?? [])
      const ifAllItemTab = defaultSlotTabs
        .every((slot) => slot.type === ItemTab && !!slot.props?.tabName)
      if (!ifAllItemTab) {
        throw new Error(`SwitchTabs: 子组件必须是 ItemTab，且必须有 tabName 属性`)
      }

      return (
        <div class="grow-1 shrink-1 overflow-auto scrollbar-hide relative">
          {/* 切换标签 */}
          <nav class="sticky left-0 top-0 z-1 bg-[var(--navbar-bg-end)]">
            <menu class="flex justify-start items-center text-color-[var(--navbar-text-color)]">
              {defaultSlotTabs.map((slot, index) => (
                <li
                  key={index + slot?.props?.tabName}
                  class={cn(
                    'where:(text-center grow-1 shrink-0 px-1em py-12px)',
                    selectedClass(slot?.props?.tabName),
                  )}
                  onClick={() => {
                    _ctx.emit('update:selected', slot?.props?.tabName)
                  }}>
                  {slot?.props?.tabName}
                </li>
              ))}
            </menu>
          </nav>

          {/* 标签内容-插槽-数组 */}
          <section>
            {defaultSlotTabs.find((slot) => slot.props?.tabName === _props.selected)}
          </section>
        </div>
      )
    }
  },
})

1. 重构拆分组件，v-model 绑定多个数据 ⇧

  • 拆分为两个组件：EmojiMainTopicNav.tsx、EmojiUnicodeList.tsx

    • 渲染展示主题列表和当前选中项

    • EmojiUnicodeList.tsx

    • 切换选择颜文字编码，更新本地selectedEmojiUnicode，发布emoji、emojiHint更新事件；

import {

  defineComponent,
  type ComputedRef,
  type PropType,
} from 'vue'
import { cn } from 'cn'
import { type EmojiMainTopic, emojiTopicList } from '@/const/emojiTopicList.ts'

export const EmojiMainTopicNav = defineComponent({
  name: 'EmojiMainTopicNav',
  props: {
    mainTopic: { type: String as PropType<EmojiMainTopic>, default: '表情', },
  },
  emits: ['update:mainTopic',],
  setup( _props, _ctx ) {
    const navList: ComputedRef<EmojiMainTopic[]> = computed(() => emojiTopicList
      .map(topicItem => topicItem.mainTopic))
    const selectedMainTopic =
      ref<EmojiMainTopic>(navList.value?.[0] ?? _props.mainTopic)
    const selectMainTopic = (topic: EmojiMainTopic) => {

                  item === selectedMainTopic.value ? 'selected' : '',
                )}>
                {item}

})

import { computed, type ComputedRef, defineComponent, type PropType, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import { cn } from 'cn'
import { type EmojiItem, safeEmojiList } from '@/const/safeEmojiList.ts'
import { type EmojiMainTopic, type EmojiSubTopic, emojiTopicList } from '@/const/emojiTopicList.ts'

export const EmojiUnicodeList = defineComponent({
  name: 'EmojiUnicodeList',
  props: {
    selectedMainTopic: {
      type: String as PropType<EmojiMainTopic>,
      default: '表情',
    },
  },
  emits: ['update:emoji', 'update:emojiHint'],
  setup(_props, _ctx) {
    const selectedTopicList: ComputedRef<readonly EmojiSubTopic[]> = computed(
      () =>
        emojiTopicList.find((topicItem) => topicItem.mainTopic === _props.selectedMainTopic)
          ?.topics ?? [],
    )
    const selectedFlattedEmojiList: ComputedRef<EmojiItem[]> = computed(() =>
      safeEmojiList
        .filter((item) => selectedTopicList.value.includes(item.topic))
        .flatMap((item) => item.emoji_list),
    )
    const selectedMainTopicEmojiUnicodeList: ComputedRef<string[]> = computed(() =>
      selectedFlattedEmojiList.value.map((item) => item.unicode),
    )
    const selectedEmojiUnicode = ref('')
    const selectedEmojiHint: ComputedRef<string> = computed(
      () => selectedFlattedEmojiList.value
        ?.find((emojiItem) =>
          emojiItem.unicode === selectedEmojiUnicode.value,)
        ?.hint ?? '',
    )
    const switchEmojiUnicode = (unicode: string) => {
      selectedEmojiUnicode.value = unicode
      _ctx.emit('update:emoji', unicode)
      _ctx.emit('update:emojiHint', selectedEmojiHint.value)
    }
    watch(() => _props.selectedMainTopic, () => {
      selectedEmojiUnicode.value = ''
      _ctx.emit('update:emoji', '')
      _ctx.emit('update:emojiHint', '')
    },)
    return () => (
      <ul
        class={cn(
          'scrollbar-hide overflow-auto h-[calc(1.65em_*_12)]',
          'flex flex-wrap content-start px-.5em py-2.5px',
          'text-22px line-height-1.5em',
        )}>
        {selectedMainTopicEmojiUnicodeList.value.map((unicode) => (
          <li
            onClick={() => switchEmojiUnicode(unicode)}
            class={cn(
              'text-center grow-0 shrink-0 w-10% b-1 b-transparent',
              unicode === selectedEmojiUnicode.value &&
              'bg-blue-300 outline-1px outline-solid outline-[var(--button-bg)] rounded-[var(--input-radius)]',
            )}>
            {unicode}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    )
  },
})

export const EmojiSelector = defineComponent({
  name: 'EmojiSelector',
  props: {
    emoji: { type: String, default: '' },
    emojiHint: { type: String, default: '' },
  },
  emits: ['update:emoji', 'update:emojiHint'],
  setup(_props, _ctx) {
    const selectedMainTopic = ref<EmojiMainTopic>('表情')
    const selectedEmoji = ref('')
    const selectedEmojiHint = ref('')
    watch([selectedEmoji, selectedEmojiHint], () => {
      _ctx.emit('update:emoji', selectedEmoji.value)
      _ctx.emit('update:emojiHint', selectedEmojiHint.value)
    })
    const clearEmoji = () => {
      selectedEmoji.value = ''
      selectedEmojiHint.value = ''
      _ctx.emit('update:emoji', '')
      _ctx.emit('update:emojiHint', '')
    }
    watch(selectedMainTopic, () => {
      clearEmoji()
    })
    return () => (
      <div
        class={cn(
          'min-h-[var(--input-min-height)] max-w-full flex-grow-1',
          'b-1 rounded-[var(--input-radius)] text-14px',
          // 动态切换边框颜色 hasError

        )}>

        <EmojiUnicodeList

          v-model:emoji={selectedEmoji.value}

})

2. 设计表单验证器 ⇧

TagForm.tsx 提交前需要验证数据

  • 不推荐直接在确定按钮点击事件中写提交逻辑
    • 类型为提交 <BarButton type="submit" onClick={() => {}}>确定</BarButton>
    • 默认点击按钮提交会触发页面刷新，需要使用 e.preventDefault() 阻止默认事件
  • 推荐在 form 表单中监听 onSubmit 事件，可以通过其他方式提交：回车、键盘提交按钮和点击确认等都可触发
    • 提交时先打印出表单数据 formData 为一个 reactive 代理对象
    • 需要转化为原生对象 toRaw(formData)，即把代理对象的原始值返回，这个才是需要校验和提交给服务器的数据
  • 需要将校验逻辑和 form 组件解耦
    • 计算错误 const errors = validate(formData, rules)，其中
    • rules 校验规则按顺序一个个独立校验数据，所以是一个数组
    • 在这个数组中再具体描述需要校验的规则的对象，例如 { key: 'name', required: true, pattern: /.{1,4}/, message: 'xxx',},
    • 但是需要注意的是，为了清晰地表述错误提示信息，必填、验证其他例如字符长度等；需要分开写到不同的校验规则中，并且按照顺序校验
    • { key: 'name', required: true, message: '必填', },
    • { key: 'name', pattern: /^.{1,4}$/, message: '必须1~4字符', },
    • 每一个校验只能描述一种规则类型
    • 将错误信息展示在底部留好的节点中 form_errorHint
    • 错误的数据结构 const errors = { name: ['错误1', '错误2'], sign: ['错误3', '错误4'],}
    • 以校验规则中的 key 作为属性字段，所有错误信息放在数组中

interface FormDataType {
  [key: string]: string | number | null | undefined | FormDataType
}

type Rule<T> = {
  key: keyof T
  message: string
} & (
  { type: 'required', required: boolean } |
  { type: 'pattern', regexp: RegExp }
  )
type Rules<T> = Rule<T>[]
type ErrorsType<T extends FormDataType> = { [k in keyof T]?: string[] }

export const formValidate = <T extends FormDataType>(
  formData: FormDataType,
  rules: Rules<T>,
): ErrorsType<T> => {
  const errors: ErrorsType<T> = {}

  rules.forEach(rule => {
    const { key, message, type, } = rule
    const value = formData[key as keyof FormDataType]
    if(type === 'required') {
      errors[key] = [message]
    }else if(type === 'pattern' && value && !rule.regexp.test(value.toString())) {
      errors[key] = [message]
    }
  })

  return errors
}
  • 遍历 rules，解构出各个属性，获取属性值 formData[key]
  • 通过 type 字段判断规则类型，最不同分支逻辑
  • 通过各个分支验证条件，将规则报错信息放入 errors[key] = [message]，条件都是互斥的
    • 是否必要，是否为空
    • 是否满足正则

interface FormDataType {
  [key: string]: string | number | null | undefined | FormDataType
}

type Rule<T> = {
  key: keyof T
  message: string
} & (
  { type: 'required', required: boolean } |
  { type: 'pattern', regexp: RegExp }
  )
type Rules<T> = Rule<T>[]
type ErrorsType<T extends FormDataType> = { [k in keyof T]?: string[] }

export const formValidate = <T extends FormDataType>(
  formData: T,
  rules: Rules<T>,
): ErrorsType<T> => {
  const errors: ErrorsType<T> = {}

  rules.forEach(rule => {
    const { key, message, type, } = rule
    const value = formData[key]
    switch(type) {
      case 'required':
        if([null, undefined, ''].includes(value?.toString())) {
          errors[key] ??= []
          errors[key].push(message)
        }
        break
      case 'pattern':
        if(value && !rule.regexp.test(value.toString())) {
          errors[key] ??= []
          errors[key].push(message)
        }
        break
      default: return
    }

  })

  return errors
}
  • 初始化 errors[key] ||= [] 等价于 errors[key] = errors[key] || []，errors[key]为空值则将其赋值为[]
  • 可以改为 errors[key] ??= [] 等价于 errors[key] = errors[key] ?? []

    • 后端可以返回一个类型是 ErrorsType 的数据就行了

  • ts 如果声明中间变量，会预先推测变量类型，要么将类型推测得过于宽泛，要么会降类型推测得狭隘了
    • const rules = [{...}, {...}, {...}] 宽泛；const rules = [{...}, {...}, {...}] 狭隘
    • 推测后的类型无法判断其中两个属性是互斥的：regexp 与 required
    • 也无法判断其中两个属性必须都存在：type: 'pattern' 与 regexp: /hi/
    • 所以传参给 formValidate 会报类型错误
  • 或不声明中间变量，直接将字面量放到参数中，不报类型错误，因为ts就好累推测类型这部，直接判断数据是否满足类型
    • 即只做类型对比，不做类型推测
  • 推荐的做法是明确地声明其类型 const rules: Rules<FormDataType> = [...]
    • 也可以类型断言 const rules = [...] as Rules<FormDataType>
    • 也可以类型满足 const rules = [...] satisfies Rules<FormDataType> 既能做类型安全检查，又能保留最具体的字面量类型

参考

  • typescript satisfies 用法

export interface FormDataType {
  [key: string]: string | number | null | undefined | FormDataType
}

export type FormRule<T> = {
  key: keyof T
  message: string
} & (
  { type: 'required', required: boolean } |
  { type: 'pattern', regexp: RegExp }
  )
export type FormRules<T> = FormRule<T>[]
export type FormErrorsType<T extends FormDataType> = { [k in keyof T]?: string[] }

export const formValidate = <T extends FormDataType>(
  formData: T,
  rules: FormRules<T>,
): FormErrorsType<T> => {
  const errors: FormErrorsType<T> = {}

  rules.forEach(rule => {
    const { key, message, type, } = rule
    const value = formData[key] satisfies FormDataType[string]
    switch(type) {
      case 'required':
        if(isEmpty(value)) {
          errors[key] ??= []
          errors[key].push(message)
        }
        break
      case 'pattern':
        if(isEmpty(value) || !rule.regexp.test(value!.toString())) {
          errors[key] ??= []
          errors[key].push(message)
        }
        break
      default: return
    }
  })
  return errors
}

export function isEmpty(value: FormDataType[string]) {
  return [null, undefined, '',].includes(value?.toString())
}

const https = require('https');
const fs = require('fs');

/**
 * 抓取网页 HTML
 */
function fetchHTML(url) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    https.get(url, (res) => {
      if (res.statusCode >= 300 && res.statusCode < 400 && res.headers.location) {
        return resolve(fetchHTML(res.headers.location));
      }
      let data = '';
      res.on('data', (chunk) => { data += chunk; });
      res.on('end', () => resolve(data));
      res.on('error', reject);
    }).on('error', reject);
  });
}

/**
 * 解码 HTML 实体
 */
function decodeHtmlEntities(str) {
  return str
    .replace(/&/g, '&')
    .replace(/</g, '<')
    .replace(/>/g, '>')
    .replace(/"/g, '"')
    .replace(/'/g, "'")
    .replace(/'/g, "'");
}

/**
 * 去除 HTML 标签，只保留纯文本
 */
function stripHtmlTags(str) {
  return str.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').trim();
}

/**
 * 将 "U+1F600" 或 "U+1F636 U+200D U+1F32B U+FE0F" 转为 "\u{1F600}" 或 "\u{1F636}\u{200D}\u{1F32B}\u{FE0F}"
 * 只有一个反斜杠
 */
function convertUnicodeFormat(codeStr) {
  const codePoints = [];
  const regex = /U\+([0-9a-fA-F]+)/g;
  let match;
  while ((match = regex.exec(codeStr)) !== null) {
    codePoints.push(match[1].toUpperCase());
  }
  return codePoints.map(cp => '\\u{' + cp + '}').join('');
}

/**
 * 手动序列化 JSON，确保 unicode 字段中只有一个反斜杠
 * 不使用 JSON.stringify，避免反斜杠被转义
 */
function buildJSON(output) {
  let lines = [];
  lines.push('{');
  lines.push('  "source": ' + JSON.stringify(output.source) + ',');
  lines.push('  "version": ' + JSON.stringify(output.version) + ',');
  lines.push('  "total": ' + output.total + ',');
  lines.push('  "data": [');
  for (let i = 0; i < output.data.length; i++) {
    const e = output.data[i];
    lines.push('    {');
    lines.push('      "category": ' + JSON.stringify(e.category) + ',');
    lines.push('      "num": ' + e.num + ',');
    lines.push('      "code": ' + JSON.stringify(e.code) + ',');
    // unicode 字段直接写入字面量，不经过 JSON.stringify 转义反斜杠
    lines.push('      "unicode": "' + e.unicode + '",');
    lines.push('      "shortName": ' + JSON.stringify(e.shortName));
    lines.push('    }' + (i < output.data.length - 1 ? ',' : ''));
  }
  lines.push('  ]');
  lines.push('}');
  return lines.join('\n');
}

/**
 * 解析 emoji 表格
 */
function parseEmojiTable(html) {
  const results = [];
  let currentCategory = '';

  const trRegex = /<tr[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/tr>/g;
  let trMatch;

  while ((trMatch = trRegex.exec(html)) !== null) {
    const rowContent = trMatch[1];

    // 检查是否为 mediumhead 分类行
    if (rowContent.includes('mediumhead')) {
      const titleMatch = rowContent.match(/<a[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/a>/);
      if (titleMatch) {
        currentCategory = decodeHtmlEntities(titleMatch[1].trim());
      }
      continue;
    }

    // 跳过表头行（th 标签）
    if (/<th[\s>]/.test(rowContent)) continue;

    // 提取所有 td 单元格
    const tds = [];
    const tdRegex = /<td[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/td>/g;
    let tdMatch;
    while ((tdMatch = tdRegex.exec(rowContent)) !== null) {
      tds.push(tdMatch[1]);
    }

    // 数据行应该有 9 列
    if (tds.length < 9) continue;

    // 第一列是序号
    const numText = stripHtmlTags(decodeHtmlEntities(tds[0]));
    if (!numText || !/^\d+$/.test(numText)) continue;
    const num = parseInt(numText, 10);

    // 第二列是 Code (含 <a> 标签)，去除标签后得到 "U+1F600"
    const code = stripHtmlTags(decodeHtmlEntities(tds[1]));

    // CLDR Short Name 在最后一列 (index 8)
    let shortName = stripHtmlTags(decodeHtmlEntities(tds[8]));

    // 去除新增 emoji 标记 ⊛
    shortName = shortName.replace(/^⊛\s*/, '').trim();

    // 转换 unicode 格式
    const unicode = convertUnicodeFormat(code);

    results.push({
      category: currentCategory,
      num: num,
      code: code,
      unicode: unicode,
      shortName: shortName
    });
  }

  return results;
}

/**
 * 主函数
 */
async function main() {
  const url = 'https://unicode.org/emoji/charts/full-emoji-list.html';
  console.log('正在抓取网页...');
  const html = await fetchHTML(url);
  console.log('网页抓取完成，开始解析...');

  const emojiData = parseEmojiTable(html);
  console.log(`解析完成，共 ${emojiData.length} 条 emoji 数据`);

  const output = {
    source: url,
    version: 'Unicode Emoji',
    total: emojiData.length,
    data: emojiData
  };

  // 手动构建 JSON 字符串，确保 unicode 字段只有一个反斜杠
  const jsonStr = buildJSON(output);
  const outputPath = __dirname + '/emoji-data.json';
  fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, jsonStr, 'utf-8');
  console.log(`数据已保存到 ${outputPath}`);

  // 打印前几条示例
  console.log('\n示例数据（前5条）:');
  const preview = emojiData.slice(0, 5).map(e => ({
    category: e.category,
    num: e.num,
    code: e.code,
    unicode: e.unicode,
    shortName: e.shortName
  }));
  // 用自定义输出展示实际效果
  for (const e of preview) {
    console.log(`  { num: ${e.num}, code: "${e.code}", unicode: "${e.unicode}", shortName: "${e.shortName}", category: "${e.category}" }`);
  }
}

main().catch(err => {
  console.error('执行出错:', err);
  process.exit(1);
});

import { defineConfig, presetAttributify, transformerVariantGroup } from 'unocss'
import {presetWind4} from '@unocss/preset-wind4'

export default defineConfig({
  presets: [
    presetWind4(),
    presetAttributify(),
  ],
  transformers: [
    transformerVariantGroup(), // 支持 where:(a b c) 这种分组写法
  ],
  variants: [
    // where:xxx -> :where(.where\:xxx) { ... }，优先级 0,0,0
    (matcher) => {
      if (!matcher.startsWith('where:'))
        return matcher
      return {
        matcher: matcher.slice(6),
        selector: s => `:where(${s})`,
      }
    },
  ],
  theme: {
    colors: {
      // 绑定你的 CSS 变量
      welcomeCardBg: 'var(--welcome-card-bg-color)',
      primaryColor: '#6035BF',
    },
  },
  shortcuts: {
    // 将 UnoCSS 的原子类映射到你 SCSS 里定义好的 .animation-rainbow 类
    'animate-rainbow': 'animation-rainbow',
  },
  rules: [
    [/^scrollbar-hide$/, () => ({
      'scrollbar-width': 'none',
    })],
    [/^scrollbar-default$/, () => ({
      'scrollbar-width': 'auto',
    })],
  ],
})

import { defineComponent, ref } from 'vue'
import { cn } from 'cn'
import { type EmojiMainTopic, emojiTopicList, type EmojiSubTopic } from '@/const/emojiTopicList.ts'
import { safeEmojiList } from '@/const/safeEmojiList.ts'

export const EmojiSelector = defineComponent({
  name: 'EmojiSelector',
  setup(/* _props, _ctx */) {
    const navList: EmojiMainTopic[] = emojiTopicList
      .map(topicItem => topicItem.mainTopic)
    const selectedMainTopic = ref<EmojiMainTopic>(navList[0] ?? '表情')
    const selectedTopicList: readonly EmojiSubTopic[] = emojiTopicList
      .find(topicItem => topicItem.mainTopic === selectedMainTopic.value)
      ?.topics ?? []
    const flattedTopicEmojiList: string[] = safeEmojiList
      .filter(item => selectedTopicList.includes(item.topic))
      .flatMap(item => item.emoji_list)
      .map(item => item.unicode)

    return () => (
      <div
        class={cn(
          'formItem emojiList error',
          'min-h-[var(--input-min-height)] max-w-full flex-grow-1',
          'b-1 rounded-[var(--input-radius)] text-14px',
          // 动态切换边框颜色 hasError
          Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'b-[var(--input-border-color)]' : 'b-[var(--error-color)]',

        <nav
          class={cn(
            'flex flex-nowrap overflow-auto mx-1em py-0 scrollbar-hide',
            '[&>span]:(shrink-0 inline-block p-.5em text-[var(--emoji-nav-text)] whitespace-nowrap)',
            '[&>span.selected]:(text-[var(--emoji-nav-text-selected)] font-bold)',
          )}>
          {navList.map((item) => (
            <span class={item === selectedMainTopic.value ? 'selected' : ''}>

            </span>
          ))}
        </nav>

        <ul
          class={cn(
            'scrollbar-hide overflow-auto max-h-[calc(1.5em_*_12)]',
            'flex flex-wrap content-start px-.5em py-0 text-22px line-height-1.5em',
            'children:(grow-0 shrink-0 w-10%) text-center',
          )}>
          {flattedTopicEmojiList.map(unicode => (<li>{unicode}</li>)) }
        </ul>
      </div>
    )
  },
})

            '[&>span]:(shrink-0 inline-block p-.5em text-[var(--emoji-nav-text)] whitespace-nowrap)',
            '[&>span.selected]:(text-[var(--emoji-nav-text-selected)] font-bold)',
          )}>
          {navList.map((item) => (

          ))}
        </nav>

        <ul
          class={cn(
            'scrollbar-hide overflow-auto h-[calc(1.5em_*_12)]',
            'flex flex-wrap content-start px-.5em py-0 text-22px line-height-1.5em',

          )}>
          {selectedEmojiList.value.map(unicode => (<li>{unicode}</li>)) }
        </ul>
      </div>
    )
  },
})

import { cn } from 'cn'
import { type EmojiMainTopic, emojiTopicList, type EmojiSubTopic } from '@/const/emojiTopicList.ts'
import { safeEmojiList } from '@/const/safeEmojiList.ts'

export const EmojiSelector = defineComponent({
name: 'EmojiSelector',
emits: ['update:emoji',],
setup( _props, _ctx ) {
const navList: EmojiMainTopic[] = emojiTopicList
  .map(topicItem => topicItem.mainTopic)
const selectedTopic = ref<EmojiMainTopic>(navList[0] ?? '手势')
const selectedTopicList: ComputedRef<readonly EmojiSubTopic[]> = computed(() => /* ... */)
const selectedEmojiList: ComputedRef<string[]> = computed<string[]>(() => /* ... */)
const selectedEmoji = ref('')

const selectMainTopic = (topic: EmojiMainTopic) => {
  selectedEmoji.value = ''
  _ctx.emit('update:emoji', '')
  selectedTopic.value = topic
}

const selectEmoji = (unicode: string) => {
  selectedEmoji.value = unicode
  _ctx.emit('update:emoji', unicode)
}
return () => (
  <div
    class={cn(/* ... */)}>
    <nav
      class={cn(/* ... */)}>
      {navList.map((item) => (
        <span
          onClick={() => selectMainTopic(item)}
          class={item === selectedTopic.value ? 'selected' : ''}>
          {item}
        </span>
      ))}
    </nav>

    <ul
      class={cn(
        'scrollbar-hide overflow-auto h-[calc(1.6em_*_12)]',
        'flex flex-wrap content-start px-.5em py-0 ',
        'text-center text-22px line-height-1.5em',
        'children:(grow-0 shrink-0 w-10% b-1 b-transparent) ',
        '[&>li.selected]:(bg-blue-300)',
      )}>
      {
        selectedEmojiList.value
          .map(unicode => (
            <li
              onClick={() => selectEmoji(unicode)}
              class={unicode === selectedEmoji.value ? 'selected' : ''}>
              {unicode}
            </li>
          ))
      }
    </ul>
  </div>
)
},
})

  • 子组件触发事件逻辑 _ctx.emit('update:emoji', unicode)

    return () => (

              符号 {formData.sign}

          </div>
        </div>
      </form>
    )
  },
})
  • v-model 有多种绑定形式
    • 子组件声明默认外部数据名称 props:{ modelValue: {type: String, /* ... */}, }
    • 子组件触发事件 update:modelValue
    • 父组件在子组件节点上绑定响应式数据 :modelValue={xxx}
    • 子组件声明发布事件名称，以 'update:xxx' 的格式
    • 子组件触发事件 update:xxx
    • 父组件在子组件节点上绑定响应式数据 v-model:xxx={xXxx}

item.title: 【山竹记账前端-vue】10.使用 Vant UI 制作数字按键
item.author: xmasuhai@163.org (Joel Xu)
item.description:
【山竹记账前端-vue】10.使用 Vant UI 制作数字按键

大纲链接 §

[toc]

1. 制作数字按键 ⇧

  • 声明按钮列表数据，遍历渲染；声明按钮类型
    • 按钮支持文字或图标
  • 使用二维布局 grid 做不规则分布的按钮
  • 四列四行，其中 清空（归零）、删除（图标）、提交、0 位数字占据跨多行/列
  • 父容器布局样式 grid grid-cols-[repeat(4,1fr)] grid-rows-[repeat(4,48px)]
  • 父容器设置背景色 #ddd，留出子节点空隙 gap-1px，设置子节点背景为白色，形成类似边框线条
  • 遍历的按钮对象需要设置具体不同的 grid-area-[]，具体网格样式配置可参考：css grid generator

import { defineComponent } from 'vue'
import { SvgIcon } from '@/components/icons/SvgIcon.tsx'
import { NumberOutput } from '@/modules/items/NumberOutput.tsx'
import type { SvgIconName } from '@svgoStore'
import { cn } from 'cn'

type ButtonItem<T extends boolean = boolean> = {
  text: string,
  onClick: () => void,
  gridArea: string,
} & (T extends true
  ? {
      hasIcon: T,
      iconName: SvgIconName,
    }
  : {
      hasIcon?: false,
      iconName?: never,
    })

export const InputPad = defineComponent({
  name: 'InputPad',
  setup(/* _props, _ctx */) {
    const buttons: ButtonItem[] = [
      {text: '1', onClick: () => {}, gridArea: 'grid-area-[1/1/2/2]',},
      {text: '2', onClick: () => {}, gridArea: 'grid-area-[1/2/2/3]',},
      {text: '3', onClick: () => {}, gridArea: 'grid-area-[1/3/2/4]',},
      {text: '清空', onClick: () => {}, gridArea: 'grid-area-[1/4/2/5]',},
      {text: '4', onClick: () => {}, gridArea: 'grid-area-[2/1/3/2]',},
      {text: '5', onClick: () => {}, gridArea: 'grid-area-[2/2/3/3]',},
      {text: '6', onClick: () => {}, gridArea: 'grid-area-[2/3/3/4]',},
      {text: '删除', onClick: () => {}, hasIcon: true, iconName: 'backspace', gridArea: 'grid-area-[2/4/3/5]',},
      {text: '7', onClick: () => {}, gridArea: 'grid-area-[3/1/4/2]',},
      {text: '8', onClick: () => {}, gridArea: 'grid-area-[3/2/4/3]',},
      {text: '9', onClick: () => {}, gridArea: 'grid-area-[3/3/4/4]',},
      {text: '提交', onClick: () => {}, gridArea: 'grid-area-[3/4/5/5]',},
      {text: '0', onClick: () => {}, gridArea: 'grid-area-[4/1/5/3]',},
      {text: '.', onClick: () => {}, gridArea: 'grid-area-[4/3/5/4]',},
    ]
    return () => (
      <>
        <div class="">
          <span class="notes">
            <SvgIcon name="date" />
            <span>2027-01-01</span>
          </span>
          <span class="amount">
            <NumberOutput />
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* 数字键盘 */}
        <div class={cn(
          'grid grid-cols-[repeat(4,1fr)] grid-rows-[repeat(4,48px)]',
          'bg-[#ddd] gap-1px p-1px',
          'children-bg-white children-b-none'
        )}>
          {buttons.map((buttonItem) => (
            <button
              type="button"
              key={buttonItem.text}
              onClick={buttonItem.onClick}
              class={cn(
                'flex justify-center items-center',
                buttonItem.gridArea,
              )}>
              {buttonItem.hasIcon ? <SvgIcon name={buttonItem.iconName} /> : buttonItem.text}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </>
    )
  },
})

    return () => (
      <span class="text-24px font-mono color-[var(--amount-text-color)]">
        199.12

type ButtonItem<T extends boolean = boolean> = {
  text: string,

export const InputPad = defineComponent({
  name: 'InputPad',
  setup(/* _props, _ctx */) {
    const buttons: ButtonItem[] = [
      {text: '1', onClick: () => {}, gridArea: 'grid-area-[1/1/2/2]',},
      {text: '2', onClick: () => {}, gridArea: 'grid-area-[1/2/2/3]',},

      {text: '6', onClick: () => {}, gridArea: 'grid-area-[2/3/3/4]',},
      {text: '删除', onClick: () => {}, hasIcon: true, iconName: 'backspace',
        gridArea: 'grid-area-[2/4/3/5]', extraClass: cn('children:w-1.5em children:h-1.5em'),},
      {text: '7', onClick: () => {}, gridArea: 'grid-area-[3/1/4/2]',},
      {text: '8', onClick: () => {}, gridArea: 'grid-area-[3/2/4/3]',},
      {text: '9', onClick: () => {}, gridArea: 'grid-area-[3/3/4/4]',},
      {text: '提交', onClick: () => {}, gridArea: 'grid-area-[3/4/5/5]',},

export const time = (date?: Date) => {
  if(!date) {date = new Date()}
  // 目前支持的格式有 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.sss'
  const api = {
    format: (pattern: string = 'YYYY-MM-DD') => {
      // YYYY
      const year = date.getFullYear()
      // MM
      const month = date.getMonth() + 1
      // DD
      const day = date.getDate()
      // HH
      const hour = date.getHours()
      // mm
      const minute = date.getMinutes()
      // ss
      const second = date.getSeconds()
      // sss
      const millisecond = date.getMilliseconds()

      return pattern
        .replace(/YYYY/g, year.toString())
        // 使用 padStart 长度不足则补零
        .replace(/MM/g, month.toString().padStart(2, '0'))
        .replace(/DD/g, day.toString().padStart(2, '0'))
        .replace(/HH/g, hour.toString().padStart(2, '0'))
        .replace(/mm/g, minute.toString().padStart(2, '0'))
        .replace(/ss/g, second.toString().padStart(2, '0'))
        .replace(/sss/g, millisecond.toString().padStart(3, '0'))
    }
  }

  return {
    api,
  }
}

import { computed, defineComponent, ref } from 'vue'
import { SvgIcon } from '@/components/icons/SvgIcon.tsx'
import { NumberOutput } from '@/modules/items/NumberOutput.tsx'
import { Numpad } from '@/modules/items/Numpad.tsx'
import { time } from '@/shared/time.ts'
import { DatePicker, Popup } from 'vant'

export const InputPad = defineComponent({
  name: 'InputPad',
  setup(/* _props, _ctx */) {
    const datePickerVisibleRef = ref(false)
    const lastDateRef = ref(['2026', '11', '01'])
    const currentDateRef = ref(['2026', '11', '01'])
    const minDate = new Date(2025, 1, 1)
    const maxDate = new Date(2028, 0, 1)
    const formattedDateStr = computed(() =>
      time(new Date(currentDateRef.value.join('-'))).api.format(),
    )
    const toggleDatePicker = () => {
      datePickerVisibleRef.value = !datePickerVisibleRef.value
    }
    const confirmDate = ({ selectedValues }: {selectedValues: string[]}) => {
      lastDateRef.value = selectedValues
      currentDateRef.value = selectedValues
      datePickerVisibleRef.value = false
    }
    const cancelDate = () => {
      currentDateRef.value = lastDateRef.value
      datePickerVisibleRef.value = false
    }

    return () => (
      <>
        {/* 日期、金额输入 */}
        <div class="flex justify-between items-center py-1em b-t-[var(--button-border-color)] b-t-1">
          <span class="flex justify-start items-center">
            <SvgIcon name="date" class="size-2em mx-1 fill-[var(--button-bg)]" />
            <span class="animation-rainbow text-14px font-mono color-[var(--vp-c-brand-next)]">
              <span onClick={toggleDatePicker}>{formattedDateStr.value}</span>
              <Popup
                position="bottom"
                v-model:show={datePickerVisibleRef.value}
                onClose={cancelDate}>
                <DatePicker
                  title="选择年月日"
                  v-model={currentDateRef.value}
                  minDate={minDate}
                  maxDate={maxDate}
                  onConfirm={confirmDate}
                  onCancel={cancelDate}/>
              </Popup>
            </span>
          </span>

          <NumberOutput class="mr-4" />
        </div>

        {/* 数字键盘 */}
        <Numpad />
      </>
    )
  },
})
  • datePickerVisibleRef 控制 Popup 显示状态
  • lastDateRef 为 DatePicker 暂存上一次选择数据，用来取消时，恢复上一次数据
  • currentDateRef 为 DatePicker 当前选择数据
  • DatePicker 设置范围 minDate、maxDate，格式为 new Date(2028, 0, 1)
  • formattedDateStr 配合自己封装的 time 函数，计算格式化后的字符串
  • toggleDatePicker 切换开/关 Popup
  • confirmDate 确认选择日期，同时更新 lastDateRef 和 currentDateRef
  • cancelDate 取消选择日期，由于切换日期时组件立即就会同时更新 currentDateRef 数据，取消时需要恢复上一次选择的数据 lastDateRef

// 定义所有 grid-area 的名称列表，名称不能以纯数字开头、不能包含符号（例如 .）
// 与tsx名称逻辑耦合，两边一致
$btn-names: (
  btn_1, btn_2, btn_3, btn_清空,
  btn_4, btn_5, btn_6, btn_删除,
  btn_7, btn_8, btn_9, btn_提交,
  btn_0, btn_dot,
);

.button-wrapper {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-areas:
    "btn_1 btn_2 btn_3 btn_清空"
    "btn_4 btn_5 btn_6 btn_删除"
    "btn_7 btn_8 btn_9 btn_提交"
    "btn_0 btn_0 btn_dot btn_提交";
  grid-auto-rows: 56px;
  grid-auto-columns: 1fr;
  background: var(--pad-border-color);
  gap: 1px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--pad-border-color);

  & > .button-item {
    border: unset;
    background: var(--pad-button-bg-color);

    // 遍历生成对应的 grid-area 样式
    @each $name in $btn-names {
      &[data-btn-text="#{$name}"] {
        grid-area: $name;
      }
    }

    &[data-btn-text="btn_删除"] :nth-child(n) {
      width: 1.5em;
      height: 1.5em;
    }

    &[data-btn-text="btn_dot"] :nth-child(n) {
      width: 2em;
      height: 2em;
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      font-weight: bolder;
    }

    &[data-btn-text="btn_提交"] {
      background-color: var(--pad-submit-button-bg-color);
      color: var(--pad-submit-button-text-color);
    }
  }
}
  • 定义 grid-area 的名称列表；遍历生成对应的 grid-area 子元素样式名称
  • 与tsx名称逻辑强耦合
  • 样式集中管理，而不是像 tsx 中使用 unocss 可能样式分散在不同逻辑中
  • CSS Module 中的 grid-template-areas 写法更直观

import { defineStore } from 'pinia'
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { showNotify } from 'vant'

export const useNumpadAmountStore = defineStore('numpadAmount', () => {
  const amountRef = ref('0.00')

  const appendText = (inputText: string) => {
    // 如果当前金额为'0.00'，则清空金额
    if(amountRef.value === '0.00') { amountRef.value = ''}
    // 小数点后已经有两位数字，则不能再输入
    if(amountRef.value.match(/\.\d{2}/)) {inputText = ''}
    // 已经有'.'，则不能再输入'.'
    if(amountRef.value.match(/\./) && inputText === '.') {inputText = ''}
    // 输入'.'，判断当前金额是否为空，是则首位补零
    if(inputText === '.' && amountRef.value === '') {
      amountRef.value = '0'
    }
    // 输入 '0'，判断金额是否为'0'，是则不输入
    if(amountRef.value === '0' && inputText === '0') {
      inputText = ''
    }
    // 输入 '1' ~' 9'.判断金额是否为'0'，是则替换为1~9
    if((/[1-9]/g).test(inputText) && amountRef.value === '0') {
      amountRef.value = inputText
      inputText = ''
    }
    // 位数超过10位数字，则不能再输入，并提示
    if((amountRef.value).replace('.', '').length > 10) {
      showNotify({ type: 'warning', position: 'bottom', message: '输入的位数不支持超过10位', })
      inputText = ''
    }
    amountRef.value += inputText
  }

  const clearText = () => { amountRef.value = '0.00' }

  const backspaceText = () => {
    amountRef.value = amountRef.value.slice(0, -1)
    // 删空则补零
    if(amountRef.value === '') { amountRef.value = '0'}
  }

  return {
    amountRef,
    appendText,
    clearText,
    backspaceText,
  }
})

import { defineStore } from 'pinia'
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { showNotify } from 'vant'

export const useNumpadAmountStore = defineStore('numpadAmount', () => {
  const amountRef = ref('0.00')

  const appendText = (inputText: string) => {
    const conditions = [
      {
        ruleHint: `输入时，如果当前金额为'0.00'，则清空金额`,
        check: () => amountRef.value === '0.00',
        action: () => { amountRef.value = '' },
      },
      {
        ruleHint: `小数点后已经有两位数字，则不能再输入`,
        check: () => (/\.\d{2}/).test(amountRef.value),
        action: () => { inputText = '' },
      },
      {
        ruleHint: `已经有'.'，则不能再输入'.'`,
        check: () => amountRef.value.includes('.') && inputText === '.',
        action: () => { inputText = '' },
      },
      {
        ruleHint: `输入'.'，判断当前金额是否为空，是则首位补零`,
        check: () => inputText === '.' && amountRef.value === '',
        action: () => {amountRef.value = '0'},
      },
      {
        ruleHint: `输入 '0'，判断金额是否为'0'，是则不输入`,
        check: () => amountRef.value === '0' && inputText === '0',
        action: () => {inputText = ''},
      },
      {
        ruleHint: `输入 '1' ~ ' 9'，判断当前金额是否为'0'，是则替换为 '1' ~ ' 9'`,
        check: () => (/[1-9]/g).test(inputText) && amountRef.value === '0',
        action: () => {
          amountRef.value = inputText
          inputText = ''
        },
      },
      {
        ruleHint: `位数超过10位数字，则不能再输入，并提示`,
        check: () => (amountRef.value).replace('.', '').length > 10,
        action: () => {
          inputText = ''
          showNotify({ type: 'warning', position: 'bottom', message: '输入的位数不支持超过10位', })
        },
      },
    ]
    conditions
      ?.forEach(condition => {
        if(condition.check()) {condition.action()}
      })
    amountRef.value += inputText
  }

  const clearText = () => { amountRef.value = '0.00' }

  const backspaceText = () => {
    amountRef.value = amountRef.value.slice(0, -1)
    // 删空则补零
    if(amountRef.value === '') { amountRef.value = '0'}
  }

  return {
    amountRef,
    appendText,
    clearText,
    backspaceText,
  }
})

import { type GlobalHintPayload, } from '@/shared/events/useGlobalHintsBus.ts'
import { showNotify } from 'vant'

export const numberLimitListener = (hint?: GlobalHintPayload) => {
  if (typeof hint === 'string') {

}

      },
      {
        ruleHint: `输入 '0'，判断金额是否为'0'，是则不输入`,
        // ...
      },
      {
        ruleHint: `输入 '1' ~ ' 9'，判断当前金额是否为'0'，是则替换为 '1' ~ ' 9'`,
        // ...
      },
      {
        ruleHint: `位数超过10位数字，则不能再输入，并提示`,
        check: () => amountRef.value.replace('.', '').length >= 10,
        action: () => {
          inputText = ''
          emit({ type: 'warning', position: 'bottom', message: '输入的数字长度不支持超过10位' })
        },
      },
    ]
    conditions?.forEach((condition) => {
      if (condition.check()) {
        condition.action()
      }
    })
    amountRef.value += inputText
  }

  const clearText = () => {
    amountRef.value = '0.00'
  }

  const backspaceText = () => {
    amountRef.value = amountRef.value.slice(0, -1)
    // 删空则补零
    if (amountRef.value === '') {
      amountRef.value = '0'
    }
  }

  return {
    amountRef,
    appendText,
    clearText,
    backspaceText,
  }
})

import { useGlobalHintsBus, } from '@/shared/events/useGlobalHintsBus.ts'
import { numberLimitListener } from '@/modules/items/itemEvents.ts'
import { useNumpadButtons } from '@/modules/items/useNumpadButtons.ts'

export const Numpad = defineComponent({
  // eslint-disable-next-line vue/multi-word-component-names
  name: 'Numpad',
  setup(/* _props, _ctx */) {
    const {on, off,} = useGlobalHintsBus()
    const unsubscribe = on(numberLimitListener)
    onBeforeUnmount(() => { off(numberLimitListener);unsubscribe() })
    const numberSizeClass = (text: string) =>
      (/[0-9|dot]/g.test(text) ? cn('text-18px') : '')
    const {numpadButtons}  = useNumpadButtons()
    return () => (
      <div
        class={cn(
          'grid grid-cols-[repeat(4,1fr)] grid-rows-[repeat(4,56px)]',
          'bg-[var(--pad-border-color)] gap-1px p-t-1px',

        style={{

          'btn_1 btn_2 btn_3 btn_clear'
          'btn_4 btn_5 btn_6 btn_backspace'
          'btn_7 btn_8 btn_9 btn_submit'
          'btn_0 btn_0 btn_dot btn_submit'

import { cn } from 'cn'
import { useNumpadAmountStore } from '@/stores/useNumpadAmountStore.ts'

type ButtonItem<T extends boolean = boolean> = {
  id: string
  text: string
  onClick: () => void
  extraClass?: string
} & (T extends true
  ? {
      hasIcon: T
      iconName: SvgIconName
    }
  : {
      hasIcon?: false
      iconName?: never
    })

export const useNumpadButtons = () => {
  const { appendText, clearText, backspaceText } = useNumpadAmountStore()
  const numpadButtons: ButtonItem[] = [
    { id: '1', text: '1', onClick: () => appendText('1') },
    { id: '2', text: '2', onClick: () => appendText('2') },
    { id: '3', text: '3', onClick: () => appendText('3') },
    { id: 'clear', text: Math.random() > 0.5 ? '归零' : '清空', onClick: () => clearText() },
    { id: '4', text: '4', onClick: () => appendText('4') },
    { id: '5', text: '5', onClick: () => appendText('5') },
    { id: '6', text: '6', onClick: () => appendText('6') },
    {
      id: 'backspace',
      text: '退格',
      onClick: () => backspaceText(),
      hasIcon: true,
      iconName: 'backspace',
      extraClass: cn('children:(size-1.5em)'),
    },
    { id: '7', text: '7', onClick: () => appendText('7') },
    { id: '8', text: '8', onClick: () => appendText('8') },
    { id: '9', text: '9', onClick: () => appendText('9') },
    {
      id: 'submit',
      text: '提交',
      onClick: () => {
        clearText()
      },
      extraClass: cn('bg-[var(--pad-submit-button-bg-color)] text-[var(--button-text-color)]'),
    },
    { id: '0', text: '0', onClick: () => appendText('0') },
    {
      id: 'dot',
      text: 'dot',
      onClick: () => appendText('.'),
      hasIcon: true,
      iconName: 'decimal_point',
      extraClass: cn('children:(size-2em translate-y-[-9px] font-extrabold)'),
    },
  ]

  return { numpadButtons }
}

export const StartAccountsView = defineComponent({

4. 实现 Tabs 功能 ⇧

  • SwitchTabs 通过默认插槽获取子组件 ItemTab，并通过 props 传入 selected 属性，来控制当前选中的 tab
  • props.selected 和 遍历的 slot.props?.tabName 进行比较，来判断当前 tab 是否被选中，添加 selected 样式
  • 添加 onUpdateSelected 事件处理函数，更新 selected 的值，来实现 tab 切换功能
    • 通过 props 中的 onUpdateSelected 回调函数，执行时传入当前 tab 的名称，来更新父组件的状态

import { defineComponent, type PropType } from 'vue'
import { ItemTab } from '@/components/tab/ItemTab.tsx'
import { cn } from 'cn'

export const SwitchTabs = defineComponent({
  name: 'SwitchTabs',
  props: {
    selected: {
      type: String as PropType<string>,
    },
    onUpdateSeleted: {
      type: Function as PropType<(name: string) => void>,
    },
  },
  setup( _props, _ctx ) {
    return () => {
      const defaultSlotsArray = _ctx.slots?.default?.() ?? []
      const ifAllItemTab = defaultSlotsArray
        .every(slot => slot.type === ItemTab &&
          !!slot.props?.tabName)
      if (!ifAllItemTab) {
        throw new Error(`SwitchTabs: 子组件必须是 ItemTab，且必须有 tabName 属性`)
      }
      return (
        <>
          {/* 切换标签 */}
          <nav>
            <menu>
              {defaultSlotsArray
                .map((slot, index) => (
                  <li
                    key={index + slot?.props?.tabName}
                    class={cn(
                      _props.selected === slot?.props?.tabName ? 'bg-red' : ''
                    )}
                    onClick={() => {_props.onUpdateSeleted?.(slot?.props?.tabName)}}>
                    {slot?.props?.tabName}
                  </li>
                ))}
            </menu>
          </nav>

          {/* 标签内容 */}

        </>
      )
    }
  },
})

                <ItemTab tabId="expenses" tabName="支出">支出 icon 列表</ItemTab>
                <ItemTab tabId="incomes" tabName="收入">收入 icon 列表</ItemTab>
              </SwitchTabs>
            </>
          ),
        }}
      </MainLayout>
    )
  },
})

import { defineComponent, type PropType } from 'vue'
import { ItemTab } from '@/components/tab/ItemTab.tsx'
import { cn } from 'cn'

export const SwitchTabs = defineComponent({
  name: 'SwitchTabs',
  props: {
    selected: {
      type: String as PropType<string>,
    },
  },
  setup(_props, _ctx) {
    const selectedClass = (tabName: string) => _props.selected === tabName
      ? cn(
        'relative',
        `after:(content-[""] block absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-full h-4px bg-[var(--tabs-indicator-bg)])`,
      )
      : ''

    return () => {
      const defaultSlotTabs = _ctx.slots?.default?.() ?? []
      const ifAllItemTab = defaultSlotTabs.every(
        (slot) => slot.type === ItemTab && !!slot.props?.tabName,
      )
      if (!ifAllItemTab) {
        throw new Error(`SwitchTabs: 子组件必须是 ItemTab，且必须有 tabName 属性`)
      }

      return (
        <>
          {/* 切换标签 */}
          <nav>
            <menu class="flex justify-between items-center text-color-[var(--navbar-text-color)]">
              {defaultSlotTabs.map((slot, index) => (
                <li
                  key={index + slot?.props?.tabName}
                  class={cn(
                    'flex-grow-1 flex-shrink-0 text-center',
                    'p-y-12px bg-[var(--navbar-bg-end)]',
                    selectedClass(slot?.props?.tabName)
                  )}
                  onClick={() => {
                    _ctx.emit('update:selected', slot?.props?.tabName)

    }

})

    import { defineComponent, type PropType } from 'vue'
import { cn } from 'cn'
import { svgIconNames, type SvgIconNames } from '@/components/icons/svgIconNames.ts'

interface SvgIconProps {
name: SvgIconNames
}

/**
* @Description: 图标组件
* @Description: 默认使用插件 vite-plugin-svg-icons-ng
* @Description: 替换使用插件 svgoStore
* @FilePath: content/post/山竹记账/【山竹记账前端-vue】8.业务与轮子的关系.md
*/
export const SvgIcon = defineComponent<SvgIconProps>({
name: 'SvgIcon',
props: {
name: {
  type: String as PropType<SvgIconNames>,
  required: true,
  validator: (value: unknown) =>
    typeof value === 'string' && (svgIconNames as readonly string[]).includes(value),
},
},
setup(props, _ctx) {
// 添加验证
if (!props.name || !(svgIconNames as readonly string[]).includes(props.name)) {
  console.error(`Invalid icon name: ${props.name}`)
}

return () => (
  <svg
    class={cn(
      'where:(h-1em w-1em align-[-0.15em] fill-[currentColor] overflow-clip)',
    )}
    aria-hidden="true">
    <use xlinkHref={`#icon-${props.name}`}/>
  </svg>
)
},
})

import { defineComponent, type PropType } from 'vue'

type DirectionType =  'horizontal' | 'vertical' | '|' | '-'
interface PlaceCenterProps {
  direction?: DirectionType
}

export const PlaceCenter = defineComponent<PlaceCenterProps>({
  name: 'PlaceCenter',
  props: {
    direction: {
      type: String as PropType<PlaceCenterProps['direction']>,
      required: false,
      default: 'horizontal',
    }
  },
  setup( _props, _ctx ) {
    const direction = _props.direction ?? 'horizontal'
    const flexDirection = cn(['horizontal', '-'].includes(direction) ? 'flex-row' : 'flex-col')
    return () => (
      <section class={cn(
        'flex place-items-center place-content-center',
        flexDirection,
      )}>
        {_ctx.slots?.default?.()}
      </section>
    )
  },
})

import { defineStore } from 'pinia'
import { ref } from 'vue'

export const useOverlayStore = defineStore('overlay', () => {
  const overlayVisible = ref(false)

  const toggleOverlay = () => {
    overlayVisible.value = !overlayVisible.value
  }
  const closeOverlay = () => {
    overlayVisible.value = false
  }

  return {
    overlayVisible,
    toggleOverlay,
    closeOverlay,
  }
})

2. 实现思路与为 useSwipe 搭框架 ⇧

3. 监听 Touch / Pointer 事件 ⇧

思路

  • onMounted 组件挂载后再监听事件
    • 手指先按下 对应 ontouchstart
    • 手指滑动 对应 ontouchmove
    • 手指松开 对应 ontouchend
  • 移动方向判定：手指按下的瞬间，记录一个坐标；在移动时，记录一个坐标，并对比大小
    • y 坐标轴向下，x 坐标轴向右
    • 松开时y坐标比按下时y坐标大，则向下移动
    • 松开时x坐标比按下时x坐标大，则向右移动

import { computed, type ComputedRef, onMounted, onUnmounted, ref, type Ref } from 'vue'

type Point = { x: number; y: number }

interface SwipeState {
  isSwiping: Ref<boolean>
  direction: ComputedRef<'' | 'right' | 'left' | 'up' | 'down'>
  distance: ComputedRef<Point | null>
}

const calcDistance = (start: Point, end: Point) => {
  return {
    x: end.x - start.x,
    y: end.y - start.y,
  }
}

const calcDirection = (distance: Point) => {
  if(!distance) { return '' }
  const { x, y } = distance
  if(Math.abs(x) > Math.abs(y)) {
    return x > 0 ? 'right' : 'left'
  }
  return y > 0 ? 'down' : 'up'
}

export const useSwipe = (elementRef: Ref<HTMLElement | null>): SwipeState => {
  const start = ref<Point | null>(null)
  const end = ref<Point | null>(null)
  const isSwiping = ref(false)
  const distance = computed(() => {
    if(!start.value || !end.value) { return null }
    return calcDistance(start.value, end.value)
  })

  const direction = computed(() => {
    if(!distance.value || !isSwiping.value) { return '' }
    return calcDirection(distance.value)
  })

  const aborter = new AbortController()
  const opt = { signal: aborter.signal }

  const onStart = (e: TouchEvent) => {
    start.value = {
      x: e.touches[0]?.screenX ?? 0,
      y: e.touches[0]?.screenY ?? 0,
    }
    end.value = null
    isSwiping.value = true
  }

  const onMove = (e: TouchEvent) => {
    end.value = {
      x: e.touches[0]?.screenX ?? 0,
      y: e.touches[0]?.screenY ?? 0,
    }
  }

  const onEnd = () => {
    isSwiping.value = false
    start.value = null
    end.value = null
  }

  onMounted(() => {
    if(!elementRef.value) {return}
    elementRef.value.addEventListener('touchstart', onStart, opt)
    elementRef.value.addEventListener('touchmove', onMove, opt)
    elementRef.value.addEventListener('touchend', onEnd, opt)
  })

  onUnmounted(() => {aborter.abort()})

  // noinspection JSAnnotator
  return {
    isSwiping,
    direction,
    distance,
  }
}
  • 坐标数据类型 type Point = {x: number; y: number}
  • 记录开始按下的坐标 const start = ref<Point>()
  • 记录松开的坐标 const end = ref<Point>()
  • 只处理单指点击的情况 e.touches[0]
  • 记录是否在移动 const isSwiping = ref(false)
  • 计算移动距离：<开始坐标 - 结束坐标>
    • x: end.x - start.x
    • y: end.y - start.y
    • 使用计算属性做缓存
  • 根据 start 和 end 计算方向：
    • 先判断 x、y 绝对值距离更大的一方作为主要方向
    • 再根据 x、y 和 0 比较结果返回方向字符串
    • 使用计算属性做缓存
  • 回调函数 onStart
    • 记录开始位移坐标，清空上一次结束坐标位移
    • 将是否滑动状态设置为 true
  • 回调函数 onMove
    • 记录当前位移坐标为结束坐标
  • 回调函数 onEnd
    • 清空开始坐标和结束坐标
    • 将是否滑动状态设置为 false
  • 声明终止控制器 const aborter = new AbortController()
    • 声明监听事件选项 const opt = { signal: aborter.signal }
  • onMounted 组件挂载后再监听事件，添加三个回调，并提供参数选项 opt 终止信号
  • onUnmounted 组件卸载，终止控制器取消监听事件
    • aborter.abort()

export const throttle = (fn: () => void, delay: number = 500) => {
    let timer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null
    return () => {
      if (timer) {
        return
      }
      fn()
      timer = setTimeout(() => {
        timer = null
      }, delay)
    }
  }

import { computed, type ComputedRef, onMounted, onUnmounted, ref, type Ref } from 'vue'

type Point = { x: number; y: number }
interface SwipeState {
  isSwiping: Ref<boolean>
  direction: ComputedRef<'' | 'right' | 'left' | 'up' | 'down'>
  distance: ComputedRef<Point | null>
}
interface EventOptions {
  beforeStart?: (e: TouchEvent) => void,
  afterStart?: (e: TouchEvent) => void,
  beforeMove?: (e: TouchEvent) => void,
  afterMove?: (e: TouchEvent) => void,
  beforeEnd?: (e: TouchEvent) => void,
  afterEnd?: (e: TouchEvent) => void,
}

const calcDistance = (start: Point, end: Point) => {
  return {
    x: end.x - start.x,
    y: end.y - start.y,
  }
}

const calcDirection = (distance: Point) => {
  if (!distance) {
    return ''
  }
  const { x, y } = distance
  if (Math.abs(x) > Math.abs(y)) {
    return x > 0 ? 'right' : 'left'
  }
  return y > 0 ? 'down' : 'up'
}

export const useSwipe = (
  elementRef: Ref<HTMLElement | null>,
  eventOptions?: EventOptions,
): SwipeState => {
  const {
    beforeStart,
    afterStart,
    beforeMove,
    afterMove,
    beforeEnd,
    afterEnd,
  } = eventOptions ?? {}

  const start = ref<Point>()
  const end = ref<Point>()
  const isSwiping = ref(false)
  const distance = computed(() => {
    if (!start.value || !end.value) {
      return null
    }
    return calcDistance(start.value, end.value)
  })

  const direction = computed(() => {
    if (!distance.value || !isSwiping.value) {
      return ''
    }
    return calcDirection(distance.value)
  })

  const aborter = new AbortController()
  const opt = { signal: aborter.signal }

  const onStart = (e: TouchEvent) => {
    beforeStart?.(e)
    start.value = {
      x: e.touches[0]?.screenX ?? 0,
      y: e.touches[0]?.screenY ?? 0,
    }
    end.value = void 0
    isSwiping.value = true
    afterStart?.(e)
  }

  const onMove = (e: TouchEvent) => {
    beforeMove?.(e)
    end.value = {
      x: e.touches[0]?.screenX ?? 0,
      y: e.touches[0]?.screenY ?? 0,
    }
    afterMove?.(e)
  }

  const onEnd = (e: TouchEvent) => {
    beforeEnd?.(e)
    isSwiping.value = false
    start.value = void 0
    end.value = void 0
    afterEnd?.(e)
  }

  onMounted(() => {
    if (!elementRef.value) {
      return
    }
    elementRef.value.addEventListener('touchstart', onStart, opt)
    elementRef.value.addEventListener('touchmove', onMove, opt)
    elementRef.value.addEventListener('touchend', onEnd, opt)
  })

  onUnmounted(() => {
    aborter.abort()
  })

  // noinspection JSAnnotator
  return {
    isSwiping,
    direction,
    distance,
  }
}

export const throttle = <P>(fn: (...args: P[]) => void, delay: number = 500) => {
    let timer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null
    return (...args: P[]) => {

let result: ReturnType<F>
return (...args: Parameters<F>) => {
if (timer) {
  return result
}
result = fn(...args)
timer = setTimeout(() => {
  timer = null
}, delay)
return result
}
}

6. 选看：对比同行的代码，VueUse 社区的实现 usePointerSwipe 和 useSwipe ⇧

安装 @vueuse/core

1

pnpm i @vueuse/core@15.0.0

使用 usePointerSwipe

  • 引入 import { usePointerSwipe } from '@vueuse/core'
  • 替换 const { isSwiping, direction } = usePointerSwipe(mainRef) 即可

使用 useSwipe

  • 引入 import { useSwipe } from '@vueuse/core'
  • 替换 const { isSwiping, direction } = useSwipe(mainRef) 即可

总结 ⇧

  • 纯函数式写法不支持vue组件生命周期钩子函数，包括使用了生命周期钩子的自定义封装的钩子函数
  • 使用 AbortController 可卸载事件监听
  • 使用 e.preventDefault() 可阻止手机默认的整个页面弹性滑动效果

0. 解决图标加载不流畅方案：自制 Vite SVG Sprites 插件 v.s. 社区插件 ⇧

解决图标加载不流畅 logo 图标资源加载可能比较慢

  • 在第一页时，就提前加载所有页面的图标资源，需要一劳永逸地解决
  • 将所有分散的 SVG 资源统一放入一个 大 SVG，在 body 中预加载先，组件其他部分使用时就不需要再次加载
  • 使用 SVG Sprites 代替已经过时的 png 图片精灵图

1. 方案一：自制 Vite SVG Sprites Plugin ⇧

安装与配置 ⇧

需要依赖两个基础的库

  • svgstore 存放所有图标，用法
  • svgo 优化图标，优化用法 optimize

安装

  • pnpm add -D svgo@4.1.0 svgstore@3.0.1

import path from 'node:path'
import fs from 'node:fs'
// @ts-ignore
import svgstore from 'svgstore' // 用于制作 SVG Sprites
import { optimize, type Config as SvgoConfig } from 'svgo' // 用于优化 SVG 文件
import type { Plugin } from 'vite'

export interface SvgStoreOptions {
  cleanDefs?: boolean | string[]
  cleanSymbols?: boolean | string[]
  inline?: boolean
  svgAttrs?: boolean | Record<string, string | number | boolean>
  symbolAttrs?: boolean | Record<string, string | number | boolean>
  copyAttrs?: boolean | string[]
  renameDefs?: boolean
  [key: string]: unknown
}

export interface SvgoStoreOptions extends SvgStoreOptions {
  /**
   * SVG 图标源文件夹路径
   * @default 'src/assets/icons'
   */
  inputFolder?: string
  /**
   * SVGO 优化配置
   */
  svgoConfig?: SvgoConfig
}

export const svgoStore = (options: SvgoStoreOptions = {}): Plugin => {
  const inputFolder = options.inputFolder ?? 'src/assets/icons'
  return {
    name: 'svgoStore',
    resolveId(id: string) {
      if (id === '@svgoStore') {
        // 防止 vscode 报错
        return 'svg_bundle.js'
      }
      return null
    },
    load(id: string) {
      if (id === 'svg_bundle.js') {
        const sprites = svgstore(options)
        const iconsDir = path.resolve(inputFolder)
        for (const file of fs.readdirSync(iconsDir)) {
          const filepath = path.join(iconsDir, file)
          const svgid = path.parse(file).name
          const code = fs.readFileSync(filepath, { encoding: 'utf-8' })
          sprites.add(svgid, code)
        }
        const svgoConfig: SvgoConfig = options.svgoConfig || {
          plugins: [
            'cleanupAttrs',
            'removeDoctype',
            'removeComments',
            'removeTitle',
            'removeDesc',
            'removeEmptyAttrs',
            {
              name: 'removeAttrs',
              params: {
                attrs: '(data-name|data-xxx)',
              },
            },
          ],
        }
        const { data: code } = optimize(sprites.toString({ inline: options.inline }), svgoConfig)
        return `
          const div = document.createElement('div')
            div.innerHTML = \`${code}\`
            const svg = div.getElementsByTagName('svg')[0]
            if (svg) {
              svg.style.position = 'absolute'
              svg.style.width = 0
              svg.style.height = 0
              svg.style.overflow = 'hidden'
              svg.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true")
            }
            // listen dom ready event
            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
              if (document.body.firstChild) {
                document.body.insertBefore(div, document.body.firstChild)
              } else {
                document.body.appendChild(div)
              }
            })
          `
      }
      return null
    },
  }
}
  • 声明插件 export const svgoStore = (options: SvgoStoreOptions = {}): Plugin => {}
    • 插件配置属性：
    • inputFolder SVG 图标源文件夹路径
    • svgoConfig SVGO 优化配置，见 svgo 预设插件
  • 忽略类型检查 // @ts-ignore
  • svg_bundle.js 统一存放的图标文件实际上在源代码中是不存在的，而所有图标文件放在 @src/assets/icons 目录下
    • import '@svgoStore' 解析 为 import 'svg_bundle.js' 绕过 vscode 报错
  • 加载 svg_bundle.js 逻辑
    • 使用第三方库 svgstore 来配置获取图标，传入配置选项 options
    • for (const file of fs.readdirSync(iconsDir)) 遍历所有图标路径
    • sprites.add(svgid, code) 加入到大svg文件中
    • 优化svg配置 svgoConfig 缩小 svg 体积
    • 删除部分属性 cleanupAttrs、removeDoctype、removeComments、removeTitle、removeDesc、removeEmptyAttrs、
    • 删除 ata-name 属性
  • 把解构出的代码 const { data: code } = optimize(sprites.toString({ inline: options.inline }), svgoConfig) 变成合法的 svg_bundle.js 文件
    • 使用 div 将 svg 包裹，并将样式属性变为不可见，放到 body

import { defineConfig, presetAttributify, transformerVariantGroup } from 'unocss'
import {presetWind4} from '@unocss/preset-wind4'

export default defineConfig({
  presets: [
    presetWind4(),
    presetAttributify(),
  ],
  transformers: [
    transformerVariantGroup(), // 支持 where:(a b c) 这种分组写法
  ],
  variants: [
    // where:xxx -> :where(.where\:xxx) { ... }，优先级 0,0,0
    (matcher) => {
      if (!matcher.startsWith('where:'))
        return matcher
      return {
        matcher: matcher.slice(6),
        selector: s => `:where(${s})`,
      }
    },
  ],
  theme: {
    colors: {
      // 绑定你的 CSS 变量
      welcomeCardBg: 'var(--welcome-card-bg-color)',
      primaryColor: '#6035BF',
    }
  }
})

插件 vite-plugin-svg-icons-ng 特点 ⇧

  • 开始默认将 SVG Sprite 自动注入 index html，即使不导入虚拟模块也可以获得 SVG Sprite

把图标功能标准化、工程化

  • 以本地 SVG 文件作为唯一来源：解决图标文件分散、命名不统一的问题
  • 自动生成 SVG 精灵，不再手动维护产物，解决依赖手动导入和维护路径的问题
  • 用统一方式注入与消费图标：解决图标组件复用、颜色、尺寸和响应式控制不统一，样式治理困难问题
  • 借助缓存与 HMR 提升开发反馈速度，解决开发、构建、SSR 各阶段行为可能不一致的问题

提供虚拟模块功能

  • 使用 virtual:svg-icons/ids 通过该模块读取当前全部 symbol id
    • 导入 import ids from 'virtual:svg-icons/ids'，然后遍历
    • 适用于图标选择器、后台配置页、动态渲染图标等场景

import path from 'path'
import fs from 'fs'
import store from 'svgstore'
import { optimize } from 'svgo'
import type { Plugin, ViteDevServer } from 'vite'

interface Options {
  id?: string
  inputFolder?: string
  inline?: boolean
  noOptimizeList?: string[]
}

export const svgsprites = (options: Options = {}): Plugin => {
  const virtualModuleId = `virtual:svgsprites${options.id ? `-${options.id}` : ''}`
  const resolvedVirtualModuleId = `\0${virtualModuleId}`
  const { inputFolder = 'src/assets/icons', inline = false } = options

  const generateCode = () => {
    const sprites = store(options)
    const iconsDir = path.resolve(inputFolder)
    for (const file of fs.readdirSync(iconsDir)) {
      if (!file.endsWith('.svg')) { continue }
      const filepath = path.join(iconsDir, file)
      const svgId = path.parse(file).name
      const code = fs.readFileSync(filepath, { encoding: 'utf-8' })
      const symbol = options.noOptimizeList?.includes(svgId)
        ? code
        : optimize(code, {
          plugins: [
            'cleanupAttrs', 'removeDoctype', 'removeComments', 'removeTitle', 'removeDesc', 'removeEmptyAttrs',
            { name: 'removeAttrs', params: { attrs: '(data-name|fill)' } },
          ],
        }).data
      sprites.add(svgId, symbol)
    }
    return sprites.toString({ inline })
  }
  const handleFileCreationOrUpdate = (file: string, server: ViteDevServer) => {
    if (!file.includes(inputFolder)) { return }
    const code = generateCode()
    server.ws.send('svgsprites:change', { code })
    const mod = server.moduleGraph.getModuleById(resolvedVirtualModuleId)
    if (!mod) { return }
    server.moduleGraph.invalidateModule(mod, undefined, Date.now())
  }

  return {
    name: 'svgsprites',
    configureServer(server) {
      server.watcher.on('add', (file) => {
        handleFileCreationOrUpdate(file, server)
      })
      server.watcher.on('change', (file) => {
        handleFileCreationOrUpdate(file, server)
      })
    },
    resolveId(id: string) {
      if (id === virtualModuleId) {
        return resolvedVirtualModuleId
      }
    },
    load(id: string) {
      if (id === resolvedVirtualModuleId) {
        const code = generateCode()

        return `!function(){
          const div = document.createElement('div')
          div.innerHTML = \`${code}\`
          const svg = div.getElementsByTagName('svg')[0]
          const updateSvg = (svg) => {
            if (!svg) { return }
            svg.style.position = 'absolute'
            svg.style.width = 0
            svg.style.height = 0
            svg.style.overflow = 'hidden'
            svg.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true")
          }
          const insert = () => {
            if (document.body.firstChild) {
              document.body.insertBefore(div, document.body.firstChild)
            } else {
              document.body.appendChild(div)
            }
          }
          updateSvg(svg)
          if (document.body){
            insert()
          } else {
            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', insert)
          }
          if (import.meta.hot) {
            import.meta.hot.on('svgsprites:change', (data) => {
              const code = data.code
              div.innerHTML = code
              const svg = div.getElementsByTagName('svg')[0]
              updateSvg(svg)
            })
          }
        }()
        `
      }
    },
  }
}
  • 默认识别 svg 文件存放路径 const { inputFolder = 'src/assets/icons', inline = false } = options
  • 提供虚拟引入路径 const virtualModuleId = `virtual:svgsprites${options.id ? `-${options.id}` : ''}
    • const resolvedVirtualModuleId = `\0${virtualModuleId}`

实现首页，需要分以下几种情况

  • 如果没有登录：可选显示首页，重定向到登录
  • 如果登录但没有记账：展示首页
  • 如果登录且记过账：记账列表页面

为什么要 Mock

  1. 后台接口还没完成，但前端要用到接口数据
  2. 我想篡改后台接口的结果来测试

1. 使用 swr 发送关联请求 ⇧

实现 Mock

  • 需要篡改接口的返回值，包括状态码和消息体
  • 需要mock /api/v1/me
  • 需要mock /api/v1/items
  • 判断记账账目数据长度大于零，需要跳转
  • 在页面挂载之后才发请求，使用 useEffect 模拟，多个前后依赖条件的接口会嵌套

  • 使用 useSWR 解决请求嵌套问题，内部会使用 useEffect，可以直接替代 useEffect

export const Home: React.FC = () => {
const {data: meData, error: meError} = useSWR('/api/v1/me', (path) => {
return axios.get(`https://xx.xxx.xxx.xx:xxxx${path}`)
})
const {data: itemsData, error: itemsError} = useSWR(data1 ? '/api/v1/items' : null, (path) => {
return axios.get(`https://xx.xxx.xxx.xx:xxxx${path}`)
})
// return ...
}

  • 前后依赖的关联请求可以使用技巧：const {data, error} = useSWR(data1 ? '/api/v1/items' : null, () => {})

  • 判断前一个数据是否为空来设置请求路径 data1 ? '/api/v1/items' : null

  • 当第一个请求的 data1 还未成功时，值为空，则第二个请求路径为空，不发请求

  • 等第一个请求数据有内容后，UI 重新渲染，才会去请求第二个 api

import { fileURLToPath, URL } from 'node:url'
import { defineConfig, UserConfigExport, ConfigEnv } from 'vite'
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'
import UnoCSS from 'unocss/vite'
import jsxScoped from '@10coding/vite-plugin-jsx-scoped'
import { viteMockServe } from 'vite-plugin-mock'

// https://vitejs.dev/config/
export default defineConfig(({ command }: ConfigEnv) => ({
  // base: '/mangosteen-react-1-preview/',
  define: {
    __IS_DEV__: command === 'serve',
  },
  plugins: [
    UnoCSS(),
    jsxScoped({ scopedIdAttributeName: 'scopedid' }),
    react(),
    viteMockServe({
      mockPath: './src/mock',
      enable: command === 'serve',
    }),
  ],
  server: {
    host: true
  },
  resolve: {
    // 开启 Vite 8 的原生 tsconfig 路径解析支持
    tsconfigPaths: true,
    alias: {
      '@': fileURLToPath(new URL('./src', import.meta.url)),
    }
  }
})) satisfies UserConfigExport
  • 添加配置项 define: { __IS_DEV__: command === 'serve' }，表示是否在开发环境，否则表示在部署生产环境
  • define 配置的属性会被添加全局变量中，即可访问 globalThis.IS_DEV 或 window.__IS_DEV__

参考

  • vite配置中 创建的全局变量 define: {isDev: command === ‘serve’} 和 .env的区别，以及如何取舍

item.title: 【山竹记账前端-react】8.数据请求与缓存失效之 SWR
item.author: xmasuhai@163.org (Joel Xu)
item.description:
【山竹记账前端-react】8.数据请求与缓存失效之 SWR

大纲链接 §

[toc]

0.实现首页 ⇧

实现首页，需要分以下几种情况

  • 如果没有登录：可选显示首页，重定向到登录
  • 如果登录但没有记账：展示首页
  • 如果登录且记过账：记账列表页面

如何知道用户是否登录

  • 用 JS 读取 cookie/jwt ❌️
  • 用 JS 发请求问服务器用户是否登录 ✅️

首页发送验证登录请求，展示分三种情况

  • 例如 axios.get('/api/currentUser')
    • 加载中 return <div>loading</div>
    • 加载出错 return <div>error</div>
    • 加载成功内容 return <div>Home</div>

可自行封装通用请求逻辑，示例伪代码

  • const {loading, error, data} = useAjax('get', '/api/v1/curentUser')

使用成熟的请求库 swr.js

1. swr原理介绍 ⇧

用于数据请求的 React Hooks 库

  • stale-while-revalidate 在重新验证期间过期
    • 一种由HTTP RFC5861推广的HTTP缓存失效策略
    • 这种策略首先从缓存中返回数据(过期的)，同时发送fetch请求（重新验证），最后得到最新数据。
    • 使用SWR,组件将会不断地、自动获得最新数据流。 UI 也会一直保持快速响应。

缓存失效问题：

  • 用户页面一直开着，正好超过了缓存有效时间，导致缓存失效不更新
  • 用户的另一台设备更新了数据，原来设备的缓存即失效
  • 前端数据只是后端服务器的数据库的缓存
    • 前端数据某一时刻一定会失效
    • 前端状态管理的本质：缓存管理，即存在缓存失效的问题

需要正确稍慢的结果

  • 而不是过期有可能错误但稍快的结果

自动更新的时机

  • 与用户交互部分的数据才会去更新
    • 用户请求路由跳转
    • 用户请求分页

数据获取流派

简单示例

1
2
3

const {data, error} = useSwr('me', (/* key, */) => {
  return axios.get('/api/me')
})
  • me 是数据唯一标识符，通常是 API URL
  • 回调是返回数据的异步函数，可以使用 Axios 或原生 fetch
  • 负责当 me 过期时重新发送请求
  • 返回：data 和 error

支持重复请求去除

  • 浏览器默认去重：请求路径一直，浏览器取消上一次请求
  • swr 支持一定时间内，合并重复请求
  • 使用 Axios 作为 fetcher

2. swr基本使用 ⇧

安装

1

pnpm add axios@1.20.0 swr@2.5.1

在 @/pages/Home.tsx 中使用
